description: Questions the corpus answers but the first retrieval pass answers badly: user wording instead of documentation wording, symptoms instead of terms, and Russian questions over an English corpus. They exist to exercise the expandSearch branch (docs/system-plan.md Phase 9a), which only fires when the first pass stays under sufficient-cosine; the golden set in questions.json never triggers it. Negatives here are near-topic: the widened search must not turn them into evidence.
